name: Busa Family Fund
description: Household pooled-pension / elder-care fund ledger and fairness dashboard

agentPrompts.label: Show me the fund's balance and this month's net
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-fund` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize the fund balance, this month's income/expense/net, and any deterministic insight such as a surplus, deficit, or low balance runway. This app only reads Busabase and never moves money.

agentPrompts.label: Which family is furthest from a fair share?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-fund` skill in this folder, then show me each sibling family's share and deviation from the average, and call out any family past the configured fairness threshold. State this as a neutral fact, never as advice on who should pay.

agentPrompts.label: Show me this month's ledger entries
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-fund` skill in this folder, then show me the unified income and expense timeline for the month I name, with each entry's category, amount, and the family it benefits (or 养老院/共享).
